links.comparator_used: GPT-4o without retrieval (training knowledge alone), plus GPT-4o-mini
links.outcome: Accuracy and response consistency on 599 Japanese registered dietitian exam questions, each answered five times
links.effect: Accuracy 83.5% ± 0.3% (GPT-4o-RAG) vs 82.1% ± 1.0% (GPT-4o), p = 0.12, not significant; response consistency 97.3% vs 91.2-95.2%, p < 0.001; variance significantly lower with RAG
links.tradeoff: GPT-4o-RAG showed limited performance on numerical questions; incorrect answers were more often associated with numerical terms. No cost or latency was reported.
links.quote: While the accuracy improvement of GPT-4o-RAG over GPT-4o was not statistically significant (p = 0.12), it exhibited significantly lower variance and higher response consistency (97.3% vs. 91.2-95.2%, p < 0.001).
